inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation when caregiver was not following conditions of a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows the operation did not provide the parent with a copy of the incident report within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a child was left unsupervised in the hallway while still signed in to care. The assigned caregiver left the area without verifying the child?s whereabouts, resulting in a lapse in supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows the operation did notify parents, but not immediately as required by minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: 8 out of 16 children's infant feeding sheets had not been updated within the last 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that a caregiver left a child alone in a classroom. The assigned caregiver left the area without verifying the child?s whereabouts, resulting in a lapse in supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that the caregiver did not ensure she knew which children she was responsible for. As a result, a child was left behind in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that the caregiver did not share relevant information with the incoming caregiver, including parent instructions and details about the child. As a result, continuity of care was not maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was out of ratio, when she was observed caring for 7 children instead of 5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows the operation did not report an occurrence that placed a child at risk for injury or harm as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows the caregivers reported they used physical force to make a child nap or rest during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Provide Large Muscle Development: Observed the Sit-Up Support Ring being used by an 5 month old infant as a tummy time support pillow.     This was corrected when the caregiver removed the Sit-Up support ring from the infant's chest.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Provide Large Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2417(8))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: Upon arrival, observed two caregivers in one classroom with 16 children; SAG - 17 months.     This was corrected when the second caregiver in one of the groups arrived to work.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: The toddlers' hands were not washed before eating their breakfast/snack. Prior to mealtime, they were observed playing with toys in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: During the follow up inspection, it was found that the teachers were signing and dating the infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An active background check was unavailable to review for one caregiver who was present and supervising children.     This was corrected when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One caregiver did not know how many children she was supervising.     This was corrected when the caregiver counted the children and corrected her initial answer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using: There was standing water and debirs inside of the sensory table located on the playground.     This was corrected when the director dump the water out of the sensory table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using (26 TAC §746.3407(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Observed children in one classroom sitting at the table without an activity.    This was corrected when the caregiver let the children play in centers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: In the toddler room, observed feeding bibs in the handwashing sink.     This was correceted when the bibs were removed from the sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: Observed three toddlers walking around the classroom with their training cups.     This was corrected when the director sat each child down in a chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: The operation failed to provide care consistent with the child?s needs when a child was served food that he was not supposed to consume on two separate dates while in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One caregiver did not know how many children she was responsible for during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The operation was found during an investigation to be serving candy, soda, and cupcakes to a child in care regularly which does meet the meals and snacks must follow the meal patterns established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) that is administered by the Texas Department of Agriculture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One child was unsupervised while present at the operation when the child was able to leave their classroom without the assigned caregiver being aware of their whereabouts in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: There was no incident report written for an incident where a child was unsupervised at the operation or for behavioral issues with a child that occurred at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: The operation does not have a written operational policy that addresses suspension and expulsion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Multiple children were found during the investigation to have long waiting periods between activities and/or prolonged periods during which children stand or sit specifically at the front desk and/or in the director?s office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operation was found during an investigation to be out of ratio in one classroom when they had one caregiver with 18-20 children in a classroom that is only supposed to have 15 children with one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: It was found during an investigation that children are using tablets which is not part of the activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: One child was found to be using a personal cellular phone and/or tablet throughout the day that exceeds one hour per day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: One staff raised their voice while disciplining the child humiliating the child in the classroom in front of the other children and staff, blaming the child for being hit by another child while present at the operation.   Specifically, using a harsh tone while telling the child it was their fault they were hit for following the other child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Good judgement-When a child was exhibiting behavior issues in the class, administration did not provide the caregivers additional resources or support to help the child and protect the safety of the other children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervised Naptime Daily: A child was not provided nap or rest time even though the child was in care more than 5 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervised Naptime Daily (26 TAC §746.2901)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was found during an investigation that there was one incident where a child was unsupervised at the operation that was not reported to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not share a copy of an incident report with a parent or obtain a parent's signature on it within 48 hours of when the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: During an investigation it was discovered the operation was not following the conditions placed on a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found that children are not being properly supervised when using the Make-Believe Room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation failed to properly notify CCR of an injury to a child that required medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The operation provided CCR with a falsified training certificate from Shade Tree Learning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation was not conducting monthly fire extinguisher inspections.  This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the monthly check of the fire extinguishers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a fire inspection completed within the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a sanitation inspection completed in the last 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers in two classrooms did not know how many children they were responsible for.  This was corrected at inspection when the caregivers were made aware of the correct number of children present in each classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Two infant cribs did not have snug fitting sheets on the mattress.  This was corrected at inspection when the caregivers changed the sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left on the playground for an unknown amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: Based on the information obtained, it was determined that an infant was observed sleeping on the floor on top of a boppy pillow.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left on the playground for approx. ten minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Caregiver with a pending background check was observed supervising children in care.     The caregiver was asked to leave the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: Observed one caregiver supervising 10 children, ages 13 to 18 mos, during naptime.     This was corrected when the second caregiver entered the classroom shortly after CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Current infant feeding instructions were not available for review for ten of the 18 infant records reviewed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Hearing and vision screening was not available for review for three of the students records reviewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver supervising children in care did not have a complete background check on file.     This was corrected when the caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Per the investigation, it was deteremined that a child was left unattended while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
